description: Defines a LinkedList class with methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and getting elements by index, along with an internal Node class implementation.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation supporting basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding a String data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from the list by adjusting the previous node's next reference.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Static method to find the last node starting from the given head node.
